questions.question: What does dispatch return when jira.create has its write scope but no fresh human approval?
options: An error object with code 403 and the destructive-approval reason
A successful PROJ-99 issue because the scope is sufficient
An error object with code 500 from the Jira handler
The request is queued without an audit entry
questions.explanation: policy_decide checks fresh_approval for destructive tools after checking scope; dispatch records the denial and returns error code 403 before invoking the handler.

questions.question: How long is the default fresh human-approval window?
options: 60 seconds
900 seconds
3,600 seconds
8,192 seconds
questions.explanation: Token.fresh_approval uses window_s=900 by default and requires approved:by:human to be present in the token scope set.

questions.question: Which payload condition causes policy_decide to deny an otherwise authorized call?
options: The JSON contains a string field named title
The tool is read-only and has a required scope
The serialized args exceed 8,192 characters
The token was minted for user u42
questions.explanation: After scope and approval checks, policy_decide rejects len(json.dumps(args)) > 8192 with the payload-too-large reason.

questions.question: What does Registry.search("jira") find after both demo servers are registered?
options: Only postgres.readonly, because Jira is not an MCP tool
Only jira.create, because read-only tools are omitted
Both tools, but only on the destructive server
jira.search on the read-only server and jira.create on the destructive server
questions.explanation: The registry scans each capability manifest, so the query matches jira.search in internal-readonly-mcp and jira.create in internal-destructive-mcp.

questions.question: What does the audit entry store for an email address and SSN in tool args?
options: [email] and [ssn] placeholders after redact runs
The original values, because only responses are redacted
A SHA-256 digest for the email and a deleted SSN field
The whole args object replaced by an empty dictionary
questions.explanation: dispatch calls redact on args and responses; the local regex stand-in replaces emails with [email] and SSNs with [ssn] before writing AuditEntry.

questions.question: Which transport is advertised in MCPServer.capabilities()?
options: stdio
streamable_http
websocket_json
grpc_stream
questions.explanation: The .well-known-style capabilities dictionary sets transport to the literal string streamable_http and includes the server URL and tool manifests.
